open_requirements.detail: Jin reports model B at phi=1.04, while the Liu Table-2 model-B row matching M4=2.27 is phi=1.03 and Liu's exact phi=1.04 row is model A.

open_requirements.reason: The accessible Jin validation text does not tabulate the complete primitive or total state used to start the external Liu model-B calculation. Liu defines station 3 but the accessible primary record does not directly tabulate M3/p3/Tt3 for the matching reacting run.
Jin Eqs. (9)-(10) explicitly retain Cf and define it as a wall friction coefficient, but the accessible article text does not expose the numerical Cf used for Fig. 14.

The repository production wall source accepts a Darcy friction factor. A coefficient-convention mapping must be source-defined before a Jin Cf value can be applied; no factor-of-four conversion is assumed from notation alone.
open_requirements.requirement: Cf convention to repository Darcy friction factor
